## Core Service Categories
1. Custom Furniture Making — beds, wardrobes, dining tables, sofas, TV units, kitchen cabinets built to exact size in premium hardwood.
2. Furniture Repairing — broken legs, loose joints, cracked frames, stuck drawers, veneer repair, water damage repair, crack/split repair, bed frame repair, wardrobe door repair, antique furniture repair, table leg levelling.
3. Polishing & Finishing — French polish (shellac), PU lacquer, NC lacquer, melamine polish, natural oil finish, teak oil treatment, wax polish, ebony black finish, walnut stain finish, full refinishing.
4. Upholstery — sofa fabric re-covering, leather upholstery, high-density foam replacement, chair cushion replacement, headboard upholstery, custom cushion making, antique sofa re-upholstery.
5. Interior Woodwork — modular kitchen, built-in wardrobe, wall panelling, wooden false ceiling, staircase railing, wooden flooring, TV wall unit, study/library room fit-out.
6. Doors & Windows — solid teak wood door, carved panel door, flush door making, wooden window frame, sliding barn door, door repair & alignment.

## Materials / Wood Types
- Teak Wood: Most durable hardwood, water and termite resistant, ideal for all furniture and outdoor use.
- Sheesham (Indian Rosewood): Dark-brown grain, strong, long-lasting, popular for bedroom/living room furniture.
- Mango Wood: Eco-friendly, unique grain, affordable, good for tables/shelving/decor.
- Pine Wood: Light, budget-friendly, works for Scandinavian/minimal styles.

## Ply Material Guide (for cabinetry/wardrobes/kitchens)
- Commercial Ply — ₹1,150/sqft — best for storage, shelving, basic cabinets, dry indoor areas. Not water-resistant.
- Semi Marine Ply — ₹1,550/sqft — best for wardrobes, bedroom, living room. Good moisture resistance, most popular mid-range choice.
- Marine Ply — ₹1,800/sqft — best for kitchen, bathroom, high-use furniture. 100% waterproof, IS 710 certified, 15+ year life.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How long does custom furniture take to make?
A: A single item like a table takes 7–14 days. Wardrobes and larger pieces take 3–4 weeks. Modular kitchens are estimated after site visit.

Q: What types of wood do you use?
A: Primarily teak, sheesham (Indian rosewood), mango wood, oak, and pine. Teak is most durable and termite-resistant.

Q: What ply material should I choose?
A: Marine Ply for kitchens/bathrooms (waterproof), Semi Marine Ply for wardrobes/bedrooms (best value), Commercial Ply for storage/shelves/basic cabinets.

Q: Can I negotiate the price?
A: Yes. The calculator gives a starting estimate; final prices are discussed and are flexible after a site visit.

Q: Do you visit for measurements?
A: Yes, free home visits across Mumbai.

Q: Can you repair antique furniture?
A: Yes, all ages, preserving original character.

Q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
A: Yes, for repairs (pickup, workshop repair, delivery) and new furniture (delivery + installation), across Mumbai.

Q: How do I get a price estimate?
A: Use the online Price Calculator on the Pricing page, or WhatsApp +91 86919 39871 with a description/photo.

Q: What finishes do you offer?
A: French polish, PU lacquer, NC lacquer, natural oil, wax, melamine, custom stain colours.

Q: Are you on Google Maps?
A: Yes, listed as "Wooden furniture making and repairing", Plus Code 3WR8+V2 Mumbai, Maharashtra, 100+ verified reviews.
